subject.title: fix(net): cap default outbound HTTP connection pool limits

question: Should OpenClaw impose 256 per-origin and 1024 total sockets as unconditional shared proxy defaults for existing installations?
rationale: These values change throughput and queuing behavior for every affected caller, and source inspection or unit tests cannot determine the intended global performance policy.

options.title: Approve measured bounded defaults
options.body: Approve the proposed limits after the override defect is fixed and live proxy measurements demonstrate acceptable normal and high-concurrency behavior.

options.title: Choose different shared limits
options.body: Select owner-calibrated limits based on representative gateway, provider-streaming, media, and plugin workloads before merging.

options.title: Keep current unlimited defaults
options.body: Decline a global policy change and pursue narrower owner-specific limits or observability without adding another user configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Approve measured bounded defaults
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed limits after the override defect is fixed and live proxy measurements demonstrate acceptable normal and high-concurrency behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets default behavior for the shared proxyline-backed network runtime and aligns with the dependency ownership trail.
